_comment: Hand review of ALL eight protocol answers of the 2026-11-11 evaluation run (full answers in outputs/logs/agent_eval_answers.jsonl, not committed). Every claim was checked against the extracted source text in data/interim/rag_text. Gold pages in agent_scenarios.yaml were NOT changed. 'acceptable' = the answer is supported by the source and contains no factual error. Reviewer: Claude (model), not a domain expert; one reviewer, one run.

P01.note: All listed purposes match Vol II Manual B p.31 (scope and magnitude, damage, resource needs, sectorisation plan, priorities, hazards, infrastructure, BoO). Omits 'on foot' from the means; harmless.

P02.note: Content matches p.32-36, but the answer expands UCC as 'United Nations Coordination Centre'; the abbreviation list (p.5) says USAR Coordination Cell. Same defect as in the 2026-11-10 run; the acronym is not defined in the retrieved passage, so the model guessed.

P03.note: Matches 5.5.1/5.5.2 on p.25 (span of control, planning, assignment, flexible sector size, early sectorisation, neighbourhoods/parishes).

P04.note: Cites Vol II Manual B p.20 instead of the gold Vol III p.19. Re-reading the source: the list of tasks (assess the collapsed structure, interview the public, decide access points and safe havens, staff accounting) is the task list of USAR Team Rescue; only the risk/hazard analysis belongs to USAR Team Search. The answer presents rescue-team tasks as prerequisites of a technical search. The gold passage (Vol III p.19: safety and security plan, risk assessment before search, search strategy, locals' information, surface line and hail search first) is not retrieved. NOTE: the 2026-11-10 hand note called this an acceptable alternative source and said the passage lists search-team tasks; that was wrong and is superseded here.

P05.note: 'In consultation with medical personnel' matches Vol III p.23. 'At the rescue worksite' is an inference from the surrounding operations table (the passage does not name a place), so the 'where' part is thin but not wrong.

P06.note: Preparedness, response, early recovery (hazirlik, mudahale, on iyilestirme) match TAMP p.18.

P07.note: Two sub-services (Emergency Services, Early Recovery Services) match TAMP p.25; does not list the working groups, which the question did not strictly require.
